name: toybox
description: Single binary providing many common Unix command-line utilities, used as a lightweight non-GNU alternative to coreutils and other GNU userland tools.
build: cd toybox-0.8.12 && make defconfig && sed -i -e 's/^# CONFIG_AWK is not set/CONFIG_AWK=y/' -e 's/^# CONFIG_EXPR is not set/CONFIG_EXPR=y/' -e 's/^# CONFIG_TR is not set/CONFIG_TR=y/' .config && make clean && CC=x86_64-pc-linux-musl-gcc CFLAGS='--sysroot=/mnt/nullos' LDFLAGS='--sysroot=/mnt/nullos' make $MAKEOPTS
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
